title: humanoid_parkour round input
description: Evaluation shape for one round. Courses themselves are derived inside the referee from the platform's per-round SEED; the round input only carries the (miner-visible, non-secret) evaluation dimensions.

courses_per_difficulty.description: Course instances per difficulty tier (easy/medium/hard). Total instances = 3x this.

max_steps_per_episode.description: Control-step cap per course (1 step = 15 ms sim time).

deadline_ms.description: Per-/act deadline for the policy, enforced by the referee's HTTP client.
